notes.title: Update Release: Localization Fixes & New Achievements
notes.content:
[b]Hey everyone!

We're excited to share news about our latest update! We've fixed several localization bugs to enhance your gaming experience. Additionally, we've added new achievements with awesome rewards up for grabs.

Thank you for your support and feedback! As always, we look forward to hearing your thoughts and suggestions.

Happy gaming!
Sincerely, Dirty Adventures 🖤[/b]

notes.title: You've got an interesting case ahead, detective!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We're really glad to see you here! Since it's our first release ever - we're eager to hear what everyone thinks about the game, let us know please, any feedback is welcome - feel free to share what you think. 
Sex Inspector 🚬💋 makes you experience a slice of a detective's life - a rich and famous local businessman gets murdered under mysterious circumstances, and you're the one assigned to solve the riddle! The game offers a classic 1940-ish Chicago vibes, an intriguing storyline and plenty of adult content to enjoy while figuring out the case. As a bonus for discovering our game one of the first - grab these free keys!

[b]QD3NX-6VFE0-ARDV9

Life isn't only about working, so make sure to try to balance between your own desires, tangled relationships, important choices and every other little nuance this world offers! There are also different endings - so make sure you do everything right. 
What's right? It's up to you to figure it out!

notes.title: Tell us who captured your heart!
notes.content:
Is there anyone in particular who stood off for you personally? What's that thing about them that made you pick them? Is it the attitude, looks, everything together or something completely different? Let us know who's your favourite - knowing what our audience enjoys would immensely help us in the development of the future games/continuation of this one (if we decide to make one). Maybe we can even get you something special with some of the characters - we'll see how it goes! 👀 Please, share your thoughts on other aspects too - all the constructive feedback will be heard and taken into account.

Let us know about your favourite and we might get you something extra! 😉
